items.text: Three projects I worked on were selected for the ADI Design Index 2026: Instant Handbook (teaching), OSMOSI (research) and the Museum of the Diffuse Cities of the World (public engagement)
Member of the Steering Committee on Artificial Intelligence, University of Palermo, advising the Rector on the university's AI strategy
Scientific lead of B-CIRCULAR, on circular economy from textile waste across Palermo, Cagliari and Reggio Calabria (Fondazione CON IL SUD)
Scientific lead for MUV in NEXT-GEN URBAN FREIGHT LOGISTICS (Horizon MISS-2024)
Deputy Coordinator of the Master's in Interaction Design UX/UI, University of Palermo
Speaker at Innovate4Cities 2026 in Nairobi (UN-Habitat and the Global Covenant of Mayors), with a paper on MUV's AI-driven game engine for sustainable mobility behaviour change
I am writing on digital clones for marginal rural areas: AI agents that amplify local expertise instead of replacing it. Case study: the Madonie
